description: This file implements a plugin for comparing Protocol Buffer message objects, generating comparison methods for message types and oneof fields, with support for extensions and unrecognized fields.

classes.name: plugin
classes.description: A plugin for generating comparison methods for protobuf message types.

methods.name: Name
methods.description: Returns the name of the plugin, 'compare'.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with a generator instance.

methods.name: Generate
methods.description: Generates comparison methods for message types in the provided file descriptor.

methods.name: generateNullableField
methods.description: Generates comparison code for nullable string or bool fields.

methods.name: generateMsgNullAndTypeCheck
methods.description: Generates null and type check code for message comparison.

methods.name: generateField
methods.description: Generates comparison code for a specific field in a message.

methods.name: generateMessage
methods.description: Generates the Compare method for a protobuf message type, including handling of oneof fields, extensions, and unrecognized fields.
